title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 47
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 47: the river flowing from the house, the trees on its banks, and the borders of the land for inheritance.

questions.text: From where did the waters flow out when the speaker was brought back to the door of the house?
questions.explanation: The waters flowed out from under the threshold of the house toward the east, because the front of the house faced east.

answers.text: From under the threshold of the house, toward the east
From the top of the altar, toward the north
From the outer gate, toward the west
From a spring in the plain of the Arabah

questions.text: How deep were the waters after the man had measured one thousand cubits?
questions.explanation: The man measured one thousand cubits and led him through waters that were to the ankles.

questions.text: What had the waters become by the time the man had measured the fourth thousand?
questions.explanation: After the fourth thousand it was a river that could not be passed through or walked through, because the waters had risen so that one could swim in them.

answers.text: A river too deep to walk through
A shallow pool beside the altar
A marsh given up to salt

questions.text: What was on the bank of the river on both sides when the speaker returned?
questions.explanation: When he had returned, he saw very many trees on the one side of the river bank and on the other.

questions.text: What will happen to the sea that these waters flow into?
questions.explanation: The waters go down into the Arabah and into the sea, and the waters of the sea will be healed.

answers.text: It will be dried up completely
It will be given up to salt
It will be closed to all fishermen

questions.text: Between which two places will there be a place for the spreading of nets?
questions.explanation: Fishermen will stand by the river, and from En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets.

answers.text: From En Gedi to En Eglaim

questions.text: What does the text say about the miry places and the marshes?
questions.explanation: The miry places and the marshes will not be healed; they will be given up to salt.

answers.text: They will be healed first of all
They will be filled with trees for food
They will be measured out for the priests
They will not be healed, but given up to salt

questions.text: What does the text say the leaf of the trees by the river is for?
questions.explanation: Every tree for food will grow on the banks, its leaf will not wither, and its leaf will be for healing.

questions.text: Which tribe is to have two portions when the land is divided for inheritance?
questions.explanation: The border is given for dividing the land among the twelve tribes of Israel, and Joseph is to have two portions.

questions.text: What is said about the aliens who live among the people when the land is divided by lot?
questions.explanation: The land is to be divided by lot for an inheritance to them and to the aliens living among them, who are to be as the native-born and to have inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

answers.text: They are to be sent out of the land again
They are to serve the priests without a portion
They are to have an inheritance among the tribes of Israel
They are to receive only the marshes
